headline: Bank of Jamaica Hikes Policy Rate by 50 Basis Points to Curb Inflation
summary: The Bank of Jamaica raised its policy rate by 50 basis points while proposing regulatory measures to unlock financing for climate-resilient agriculture.
why: The Bank of Jamaica adjusts interest rates to align inflation with its official target and protect macroeconomic stability.

impacts.name: Jamaican Dollar
impacts.why: A 50 bps monetary tightening increases domestic short-term interest rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The central bank's rate hike directly increases borrowing costs across Jamaica's financial system.
